description: Hook points of anything run by aos-loop whose loop.json wires them: after_start and after_stop (on_start / on_stop, today through py/tools/agent/hook_fire), and before_run / after_run, which are declared but not fired yet.

after_start.when: the loop started, before the first run of its body (loop.json on_start; also after a wake or an auto_restart, not after a hard kill)
after_start.if_failed: the loop stops (all four loop points do); until aos-loop and the wiring change, a failing after_start hook only gives a warning and the agent starts anyway

after_stop.when: the loop is about to exit (loop.json on_stop: stop, sleep, remove, shutdown, a failing run; not after a hard kill)

code.about: the code the loop exits with

signal.about: the signal it got, or null

cause.about: stop, sleep, remove, shutdown, stuck, signal, max, body_exit or error (copied as given); null when empty or unset

after_stop.if_failed: the loop exits with a failure code (all four loop points stop); until aos-loop and the wiring change, a failing after_stop hook only gives a warning

before_run.when: before each run of the loop body, after the pause check and the wait for interval_ms

fields.stage: fsm bodies only: the state about to run (the table's start state on the first run); null for bodies without states

before_run.subject: stage
before_run.if_blocked: the loop skips this run: the body does not run, the run is not counted, after_run does not fire; the loop asks again after interval_ms
before_run.if_failed: the loop stops, as after a failing run; the body does not run
before_run.not_fired_yet: aos-loop has no on_before_run key yet; nothing fires this point

after_run.when: after each run of the loop body, whatever its exit code (not when the body could not start, not when the loop got a signal)

counter_runs.about: which run this was (the same number before_run got)

signal.about: the signal that ended the body, or null

fields.next_stage: fsm bodies only: the state the table is at now (the next one after a taken step, the same one otherwise); null for bodies without states

after_run.if_failed: the loop stops with the hook's code when the body exited 0; when the body itself ends the loop, the body's result counts and the hook failure is one warning
after_run.not_fired_yet: aos-loop has no on_after_run key yet; nothing fires this point
